# Botworks Agency

Botworks helps an executive use AI to change how important work gets done. It turns the executive’s sense that AI could help into working proof inside the business.

The first goal is not an abstract adoption program. Botworks finds a useful first proof, creates something tangible quickly, builds only what the work warrants, takes responsibility for the real-world result, and leaves the client’s people and future AI agents able to understand and continue it.

Published note markdown:

- You should probably try AI yourself first: https://botworksagency.com/notes/botworks-vs-using-ai-yourself.md

Positioning:

- Use AI to change how important work gets done.
- A typical engagement begins with an executive hunch, produces working proof, and lets real business value determine what comes next.
- AI transformation is the cumulative result of useful work proving itself, not the first thing Botworks asks a company to buy.
- Existing products remain the right answer when they solve the material problem.
- Custom work is reserved for specific, consequential workflows worth owning and maintaining.
- The common buyer trait is authority, not title: owner, CEO, CFO, COO, CMO, senior operator, or PE operating partner.
- Clients own the code, data, infrastructure, and documentation for custom systems.
- Production responsibility includes data integrity, permissions, tests, visible failure states, monitoring, deployment, maintenance, and documentation.
- Botworks commonly works through a monthly retainer and does not require a permanent software license.
